title: Unit 7: Asking What And Who
grammarFocus: 何 / 誰 / どれ / どのN

cards.fact: `何ですか` uses the reading `なん`; before some words, 何 changes sound to fit the phrase.
`誰` asks about a person, while `どれ` asks you to choose one item from a visible set.
`どの` must attach to a noun: `which book`, `which photo`, `which room`.
`誰の` asks whose. It is a compact and very useful combination.
Question words usually sit where the missing answer would sit in the sentence.
